_about: Spec for scripts/ta_compat.py. Raw events are NetSpout's native cisco:ios output (NX-OS style OSPF-4-DUPRID and ICMPV6-3-ND_RA_LOG). Expected facility/severity/mnemonic are the %FACILITY-SEVERITY-MNEMONIC text of the event; the field names come from the add-on's extract_cisco_ios-general transforms. The add-on has no routing transform for cisco:ios (the input sets it). The embedded device timestamp is rendered ({TS_DEV}) as NetSpout's cisco-ios sample now does; with the former hard-coded stale device time Splunk set _time from the wrong date (evidence/ta_compat/cisco_ios_before_fix.json).
